text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job '2026-03-schema-rolling' queued for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Steps: canary -> staggered apply -> backfill. ETA 00:35. CI: all green. /cc @Sam @Jessica
Sam: Confirming canary window is 20 minutes on 2 nodes, then cutover? We should avoid global locks.
Jessica: Yep. Canary 2 nodes in us-west1, 20min observation. If no errors, proceed to staggered apply across replicas.
DB-Eng: One thing: new column add is `NOT NULL` with default, that will rewrite table. Can we add as nullable + backfill to avoid long locks?
Kevin: Agreed. Plan: 1) add NULL column, 2) backfill in batches, 3) then set NOT NULL with validate. Backfill job params: batch_size=10k, sleep_ms=200.
Sam: Works. How about index addition? Parallel create on PG12 isn't supported. Use CONCURRENTLY? That needs no txn.
DB-Eng: Use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in canary stage. For bigger tables we should run index jobs separately during lower traffic.
Jessica: Release notes draft posted to #product: "Add user_id_v2 column, incremental backfill, no downtime expected."
Oncall-Bot: Reminder: change window is 02:00-05:00 UTC. Pager schedule: Kevin primary, Rachel secondary.
Rachel: :thumbsup: I'll monitor slow queries during backfill and kill any >5min queries per runbook.
Sam: Rollback plan: keep previous DB migration script available; if we see >1% error rate or replication lag >30s, pause and fallback to read-only routing.
DB-Eng: Also pin app version to 1.9.12-canary on canary nodes to prevent incompatible writes. Ops will pin in autoscaler config.
Jessica: Canary start in 30m. I'll kick off the canary deploy and then run `pg_stat_activity` checks. Command I'll run:
```bash
deployctl start --env prod --tag 1.9.12-canary --subset us-west1:2
pgbench -c50 -T60 -h db-canary-usw1
```
Sam: Noted. If canary looks good, we start backfill job with `backfillctl --batch 10k --sleep 200`.
Oncall-Bot: Deploy started: canary nodes up (2), health ok. Logs: 200/200 checks passed.
DB-Eng: Observed a spike in locks at +8m into canary during index create on reports table. Reduced concurrency and resumed; continuing.
Sam: Decision: proceed with staggered apply but throttle backfill to 5k batch for heavy tables.
Jessica: Rolling out. I'll post final rollout summary after window.
